### Added

- (agent-platform) [Set an organization model's token limit and prompt caching](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3585) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — When adding or editing an organization's model, its admins can set `Token limit`, `Prompt caching` and `Cache time`, and the organization's Models tab shows each model's display name and settings. Needs agent-manager 3.1.0 or later.
- (agent-platform) [Say when a credential request was started with another login](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3588) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — Opening a credential link with another login than the one that started the request shows `This request was started with another login`, and says to sign out, sign in the same way and open the link again. Needs agent-manager 3.1.0.
- (agent-platform) [Write an organization's content in the organization's mode](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3595) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On an installation that keeps its configuration in git, changes to an organization applied from git, such as members, models, keys and credentials, open a pull request, which the page links, instead of being applied live.

### Changed

- (agent-platform) [One credential form link helper and one organization write error](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3591) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — Nothing changes on the pages: the model pages and the organization's credential requests share one error message and one way to open the credential form.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Offer an organization's own muster servers in the Tools step, named as muster does](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3599) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — When creating or editing an organization's agent, the Tools step offers that organization's own connectors, marked `The organization's own connector`, and no longer another organization's.
- (agent-platform) [Link an organization's models, offer Replace key for models from git, and say when Edit model saves by pull request](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3601) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On an organization's Models tab, a model's name opens its page and models from git offer `Replace key`. Edit model says when saving opens a pull request, and the Members and Connectors tabs no longer cut text off.
- (agent-platform, muster) [Keep the Customize lists' headers and short values whole](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3579) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The Customize lists no longer cut off column headers and short values, and Toolchains shows each toolchain's newest version with a count of older ones, listing them all on hover.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.42.3...v3.43.0
